tools.name: preflight_email
tools.description: Check an AI-written email before sending. Returns allow, delay, requires_approval or block with reason codes (recipient validity, sender authentication, content risk, sensitive industries, volume limits) and recommendations. Does not send email. Without an API key: 3 free checks per day per IP.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preflight_email · Private data: preflight_email · Public sink: preflight_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preflight_email · Private data: preflight_email · Public sink: preflight_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
